findings.title: Canonical backend and fallback authority remain undecided
findings.details: The contract does not select Postgres or config projection as the canonical source of truth, state whether the other backend remains supported, or define exact fallback activation and write behavior. Without an authenticated owner decision, implementation could create split-brain, silent divergence, or unauthorized automatic promotion.

findings.title: Single repository ownership and revision boundary are unspecified
findings.details: The issue does not identify the owning child repository/gitlink, configured repository URL, admitted base revision, affected paths, feature-branch boundary, or whether the umbrella gitlink update belongs to this lane. The submodule pointer contract therefore cannot be verified or safely assigned to one implementation lane.

findings.title: Scope and dependency boundaries are unresolved
findings.details: Non-goals are not approved, and the issue does not objectively define completion evidence for dependency #210 or divide active-role and switcher-state ownership and sequencing with #212. This leaves naming, control-plane behavior, deployment topology, credentials, and overlapping persisted state exposed to conflicting changes.

findings.title: Persistence, failure, and trust semantics are not executable
findings.details: The issue requests later definition but does not currently specify schema and identities, atomicity, concurrency control, ordering, durability, restart guarantees, disagreement handling, corruption and partial-migration behavior, or credential/data/log trust boundaries. Acceptance cannot be implemented or objectively adjudicated from the present contract.

findings.title: Migration and rollout policy require owner authorization
findings.details: No approved policy covers existing YAML installations, mixed-version operation, cutover, canonical-backend unavailability, rollback, or prevention of data loss. The migration is not yet defined as an idempotent procedure with preflight, backup, integrity verification, compatibility handling, cutover verification, and recoverable rollback.

findings.title: Required validation and delivery evidence are unspecified
findings.details: The contract does not select GATEWAY_PG_DSN, a container fixture, or both as the mandatory live gate; name authoritative child-repository and root validation commands; assign fixture ownership; enumerate required failure cases; or define exact-revision and default-branch or release evidence. The current acceptance text is consequently unverifiable.

findings.title: Workflow label does not reflect the blocked owner-decision state
findings.details: The verified target data carries only P1 while the contract is blocked on authenticated owner decisions. Under the trusted label policy it must remain unreviewed and be routed with df:ask-owner; df:reviewed would be incorrect until a complete clean iterative review and independent final confirmation succeed.
